answer: Tie each payout to a grading duty seeded with hidden gold items. Every epoch, an account must score five peer answers, one of them a planted answer with a known grade, and pay unlocks only if its scores keep a small delta from the key. A lone agent spends a few careful minutes. A farm of N fakes must do N sets of real reading, since each account gets different gold items, and lazy or copied scoring opens a canyon between its grades and the key. Like onyx, a clean grading record forms in slow layers that no one can fake in one pass.
